title: Imu
description: Inertial sample, up to 100 Hz. Right-handed frame: in `device` frame +x is right, +y is up and +z points out of the screen (portrait). `mount` applies the `mount_offset` setting. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; then only those are.

q.description: Orientation as unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], relative to a gravity-aligned reference frame.

accel.description: Specific force in m/s^2, as a ROS IMU reports it: at rest upright about +9.81 on +y. (iOS CoreMotion reports the opposite sign.)

sensor_time_s.description: Sensor timestamp in seconds since device boot, for precise intervals between samples.

payload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.
